voice_157:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: I'll make this quick with one blow!

voice_157:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: All die,\nso hell won't be lonely!

voice_157:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: None can halt us, now awakened!

voice_157:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: I'll stain this earth with blood!

voice_157:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: Taking one little planet is easy!

voice_157:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: We of Mycenae shall claim Earth!

voice_157:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: Humanity has no place on Earth!

voice_157:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: You shall have no mercy from me!

voice_157:r_b42ab697149a7c8a.text: I'll make this land your grave!

voice_157:r_4de4fcf3b440baf4.text: Learn the folly of defying a god!

voice_157:r_0121a166c715cdff.text: Let Lord Hades torment you in hell!

voice_157:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: A mere human dares challenge us?!

voice_157:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: Gods and demons will soon war here!

voice_157:r_bc8538e6af3d2577.text: To gods and demons,\nhumans are dust!

voice_157:r_924516c8de2b5342.text: You bear the Brand, do you...?!

voice_157:r_da1174533722333f.text: Such light\nis not for mere humans!

voice_157:r_fdeb8162976e72c1.text: You shall vanish along with Zeus!

voice_157:r_0fadb5c26df92b42.text: Humans, stay out of the gods' war!

voice_157:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: Why do you possess Zeus's arm?!

voice_157:r_15b4a90140e8a33a.text: Worthless trash has joined the fray!

voice_157:r_bf3244994760e535.text: You side with lowly human vermin?!

voice_157:r_665f01666859013b.text: Time to decide the victor is nigh!

voice_157:r_ddbe581c5ea9183d.text: That giant steel armor is futile!

voice_157:r_faae935cca0edc72.text: I rip your weak form\nfrom its shell!

voice_157:r_41997412868c48c4.text: So, your weapon is running away?!

voice_157:r_9e6cf4f389dae55c.text: How can that tiny body fight me?!

voice_157:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: Crushing you underfoot may be fun!

voice_157:r_7432ef43ed3471dc.text: A Gundam exists even in this age?!

voice_157:r_eb7ae28b53dc033c.text: A remnant of the Age of Beasts!

voice_157:r_857c4a52ce8df0fd.text: A relic of the Age of Water remains!

voice_157:r_55417493fce1d347.text: Spiral Power from the Age of Wind?!

voice_157:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: You! Are you making sport of me?!

voice_157:r_93e25418a203cb8f.text: Yes! Run about in blind panic!

voice_157:r_adeb0a29274d3d9b.text: So some humans may yet amuse me!

voice_157:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: That ship will be a giant coffin!

voice_157:r_b1de76a75a253c13.text: Ready to lose your precious ship?!

voice_157:r_5213c17e13b23de0.text: The Age of the Sun... At last!

voice_157:r_5aeeb4917340c42d.text: Fool! You came here to die?!

voice_157:r_b765659981b6516d.text: You seem eager for an early grave!

voice_157:r_0c427458bc00eb95.text: How foolish to defy the gods!

voice_157:r_774a9ab4d8fd5351.text: You know not to leave gods be?!

voice_157:r_7d2617c809fead70.text: It is already too late to flee!

voice_157:r_ceb935ccbf830724.text: Pitiful! You were too slow to flee!

voice_157:r_862ef7385bf2abd4.text: This is the price for defying a god!

voice_157:r_001cbec4d9a4283f.text: I grant your courage in facing me!

voice_157:r_8ad40afecd02b41e.text: I shall strike you down instead!

voice_157:r_26e5efec03c03d78.text: It is too late for regrets now!

voice_157:r_4ad81e88c7557a8b.text: Caught you! I awaited this opening!

voice_157:r_f2e18dfdfe0c89ea.text: So! You seek a taste of godly might!

voice_157:r_fa96676cc65bb509.text: No games! Crush them in one blow!

voice_157:r_4e37f92e7d2fc62e.text: Too weak! This is how you attack!

voice_157:r_66ab4cfe1557909d.text: Please leave the rest to me!

voice_157:r_6c13bbfd27a7799e.text: How stubbornly you cling to life!

voice_157:r_06f88dcbd3c9e738.text: This is the power of a god!

voice_157:r_45abf84f7757d6eb.text: To think my body would rot here...!

voice_157:r_edd7a13ab8f06a14.text: I, a god, have been defeated?!

voice_157:r_8165e5b41f0124c4.text: Gwooh! Is this... Is this my end?!

voice_157:r_eb643f8bf737a0ca.text: Zeus! I'll await you in hell!

voice_157:r_9b63cf1f3e0207ef.text: You damned traitor... How dare you!

voice_157:r_3701cba361f80ea5.text: Getter Rays are not to be scorned!

voice_157:r_63f429c5c68c0863.text: You merit the name of god!

voice_157:r_98ed411352a3a6ac.text: That power... It rivals a god?!

voice_157:r_862b92e63adb9734.text: Ngh! You confound me with speed!

voice_157:r_cb306ef55e49d107.text: Indeed, you do harbor their power!

voice_157:r_76f080a4881e8ab5.text: A god brought low before humans...!

voice_157:r_288133bc5b573dae.text: Why?! Why am I being overpowered?!

voice_157:r_6f95653e548f8fcf.text: Ngh! To think this could happen...!

voice_157:r_d249d68bada91ab9.text: I fight till my heart beats no more!

voice_157:r_e9b3307e9eb69f11.text: Though my body rot, I fight on!

voice_157:r_03cdac73042343ee.text: For Mycenae,\nI fear not even death!

voice_157:r_981f8fedd5414fe5.text: My fury has reached its zenith!

voice_157:r_96bb0dcde0c8c44a.text: Only your life\ncan quell this rage!

voice_157:r_a0f2074af8debbfa.text: You will regret ever being born!

voice_157:r_b5f5a97ed82acb0b.text: Human! Why do you not fear us?!

voice_157:r_2b4d8818c77b6dca.text: You seem fit to stand before a god!

voice_157:r_d520c6d5298a848d.text: Doomed! Come with all you have!

voice_157:r_099e2458cabf796f.text: You thought that could defeat me?!

voice_157:r_9736f29b11344ec3.text: We of Mycenae fear no pain!

voice_157:r_fcd05582aa5c6068.text: A mere human has struck my body...!

voice_157:r_bece29562818acba.text: You dare wound my divine body?!

voice_157:r_cd06d0820d82524b.text: This place shall be your grave!

voice_157:r_c94c6d04be583774.text: You! Do not expect an easy death!

voice_157:r_e54e2c99ef8297af.text: I can no longer let you live!

voice_157:r_bc7b9e308b879dd4.text: You are merely a false Zeus!

voice_157:r_d907fbd7bc1c4298.text: Even the god Zeus is no better?!

voice_157:r_0e0335789c5396d7.text: Only Mycenae\nmay bear the name god!

voice_157:r_a8e85bd950696403.text: I must slay it before it awakens...!

voice_157:r_33236ffa3ea95b68.text: Age of the Sun... Ere they come...!

voice_157:r_84883aa95f63ce32.text: So weak, yet you challenge a god?!

voice_157:r_25493e978ce8ff16.text: What's wrong? Is that your best?!

voice_157:r_7316666150e42960.text: Not one chance in ten thousand!

voice_157:r_ce1a22dfe3a4d339.text: You call that an attack? Laughable!

voice_157:r_dca67f68a573fab7.text: It is not even worth evading!

voice_157:r_6f94566ad37f8ff8.text: With such power, you face a god?!

voice_157:r_942ca03c9de80143.text: Your courage is all empty words!

voice_157:r_d8c669c70659e18a.text: Can't you see resistance is futile?!

voice_157:r_8f5bade7ac2db78e.text: What? Not even a proper attack?!

voice_157:r_05ea490d2f522520.text: Has terror frozen your body still?

voice_157:r_f5658c702d91db7a.text: This is a god's invincible armor!

voice_157:r_2502132569141ea3.text: Know the folly of opposing a god!

voice_157:r_1ff312798a52c8eb.text: Did you truly think that would hit?!

voice_157:r_fa07d90fca62f593.text: That was no trouble at all!

voice_157:r_a25bf2676ecf9d83.text: All your efforts were in vain!

voice_157:r_237a0288b42dce20.text: Before a god, your power is nothing!

voice_157:r_0556e8a22779ea8e.text: This too is a god's power!

voice_157:r_09d377101a48d92a.text: What's wrong? You can't scratch me?!

voice_157:r_a88939ea84b4474d.text: Hmph. You thought you outwitted me?!

voice_157:r_03f6158ef83964f3.text: Go so far merely to survive?!

voice_157:r_2970a83693cdcc25.text: Enjoy your life while you still can!

voice_157:r_8b18aa4cc69547df.text: Stay there and tremble in terror!

voice_157:r_3e87f6fc3ea65aef.text: How dare you deceive a god!

voice_157:r_5508a7bfa9074eb9.text: Hmph! You have played too long!

voice_157:r_09a003e91f0d5dc7.text: What? Did you let your guard down?!

voice_157:r_192447448ebd7bb5.text: I will not abandon an ally!

voice_157:r_207b256d613bb896.text: Lord Hades need not\nbother with you!

voice_157:r_a6fd676d8146501b.text: Know this as the blade of a god!

voice_157:r_94d35e5fa8e3a198.text: This blade shall reap your life!

voice_157:r_b686510e636673f3.text: Feel its sharpness in your flesh!

voice_157:r_09a780acca0eb4b0.text: This scythe can cleave even souls!

voice_157:r_af62f2ee466b5c8c.text: I shall reap your very life!

voice_157:r_20cfb719db02fafd.text: Behold the edge of hell's scythe!

voice_157:r_570c1fdf72edb283.text: God though I am, I am your reaper!

voice_157:r_23f0d87a5a6cfca1.text: Lord Hades gave this hell scythe!

voice_157:r_cff4d2eae8a939ed.text: I'll crush you in my grasp!
